ns2:course.label: Playwrights Workshop
ns2:course.description: Seminar course focusing on the role of the playwright in the collaborative process. Course may be repeated as topics will vary. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 9 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 211.
